integrity: Analytic proof supplied in RESULT.md; executable supplementary checks in checker.py; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves global off-diagonal attraction only for real alpha >=4 in the normalized two-maxima map. It does not assert a sharp cutoff, global attraction for 2<alpha<4, behavior on the diagonal, boundary x=1, or results for nonidentical resource updates. Proof is self-contained; finite checker tests are supplementary. Independent audit not performed.
title: Global high-resource attraction through an absorbing mixed branch in a two-maxima map
